sites.n: Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia (joint UK-US base)
sites.cs: NOAA ISD station 619670 'DIEGO GARCIA NAVAL AIR STATION' (FJDG; ISD period 19490201-20250824)
sites.kf: GOV.UK, 22 May 2025: the UK signed a treaty with Mauritius on the Chagos Archipelago under which the UK keeps full operational control of Diego Garcia, the joint UK–US base, with a 24-nautical-mile buffer zone. The cost is £101 million a year, with a net present value of £3.4 billion. The base hosts one of the four GPS ground antennas and part of the GEODSS deep-space surveillance system.
